message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are performed on the loaded data; NaN replacement is done but that is imputation, not validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from local files and HDF5 stores with no checksum verification, signature validation, or authenticated remote fetch visible in the code.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only converts labels to one-hot encoding and optionally prints label distributions (verbose mode only); there is no validation against an expected label set, no distribution comparison, and no label-noise detection tool used.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The only data cleaning performed is NaN imputation with column means (replace nan with mean); there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads a saved model using tf.keras.models.load_model() with only a path existence check, but performs no hash verification, signature check, or pinned revision validation before loading.

No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous label distributions before training; verbose debug prints of label distributions are commented out or only shown when verbose=True and do not enforce any validation.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop uses standard Keras model.fit with only EarlyStopping and ReduceLROnPlateau callbacks; there is no neural cleanse, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection for backdoor defense.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used anywhere in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a separate test split is used, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no isolation enforcement mechanism, and only a single evaluation pass with standard metrics — no explicit protection against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path in test.py calls model.predict(test_x, ...) directly with no shape, range, NaN, or schema validation on test_x before prediction.
No detected output bounds checks: The prediction array returned by model.predict is passed directly to generate_result without any NaN guards, probability-sum checks, or threshold validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a sensor-based HAR classification model, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
